Behind the companion

Trusted storytelling, innovative technology.

Zhejiang Jinke Talking Tom Culture Industry Co., Ltd. is a full-spectrum IP operator centered around Talking Tom & Friends, connecting entertainment, education, licensed products, and family experiences.

Established in June 2007 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange GEM in May 2015, Jinke continues to bring trusted stories into new interactive formats.
